axes: Roblox (x, y, z) = Blender (x, z, -y); an asset's front = Roblox LookVector (-Z); bases on y = 0 (LaunchRiserDisc: origin = the standing surface)

set.frame: the pole hall: origin at its floor centre (y 0); bearings clockwise from north (Roblox -Z). CFrame = CFrame.new(position) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(yawDeg), 0).

redRoom.placement: client-local, one per player: under the player's own bay, origin = bay origin + (0, -40, 0), same yaw (its roof top then sits 18 studs under the hall floor). Nobody else ever sees it.
redRoom.liftTravel: the rose lift disc rises from y 0.15 up through the hex frame (y 21.6) into the dark above the roof; the cut to the case hides there

rise.bayFrame: relative to the case bay's CFrame (origin = bay floor centre, LookVector = toward the hall centre); multiply by the bay's CFrame for world positions
rise.profile: accelerate 2.0 s, cruise 5.0 s at 17.14 studs/s, brake 2.0 s
rise.orbitDirection: counter-clockwise seen from above, starting in front of the case (toward the hall centre)

sequence.stage: 1 Red room (transition, loops while the map loads)
sequence.camera: first person while waiting (the room is walkable). When the map is ready: a chime, the player is set on the lift disc (Spawn) and the cinematic starts on CamTopDown: straight down through the hex frame, pushing in from y 33 to 27 over 2.5 s (the film's framing).
the disc lifts; the camera rises ahead of the player through the hex frame into the dark above the roof (hidden cut 1).
open on the player in their case (CamCase); pull back out through the front glass to the walkway and sweep 20 degrees along the curving row of cases (others stand in theirs).
rise.keys: the disc rides the pole 120 studs while the camera orbits 270 degrees round the rider, low first (looking up the pole, T1 @127.2 s), then level, then up at the aperture.
overlaps the last 0.6 s of the rise: the aperture floods white (hidden cut 2 into the arena).

Map 1: up the brass-rimmed tube in the turf; Map 2: the plate surfaces in the lagoon. The camera finishes the circle (the last 90 degrees) and settles behind the head facing the horn; then first person.

LaunchRedRoom.lights: SpotLight at KeyLight (cool white, angle 78, aimed down); a red SurfaceLight (Face Top) in each grate pit at GrateGlow_n; PointLights (warm white, range 10) at Lamp_n

LaunchCaseHall.lights: SurfaceLight (Face Bottom) on each case top-light and each gantry strip; a small SurfaceLight on each unit panel

LaunchPoleHall.lights: SpotLights (angle 34) at the 12 HubSpot_n; a SurfaceLight (Face Bottom) on every LED bar; the poles' strips are Neon only; a SpotLight that rides 7 studs in front of and 10 above each rider (the rider key)

import: Import each GLB (3D Importer). Each asset root arrives as a Model of MeshParts named <Asset>_<Part>.
Re-centre each asset: Model.WorldPivot = CFrame.new(origin), then PivotTo(CFrame.new()).
Per part from the manifest: Material = robloxMaterial, Color = rgb, CanCollide = collide, CollisionFidelity = collision, CastShadow, CanQuery, CanTouch, Transparency; Anchored = true.

Paint parts: one SurfaceAppearance per part (ColorMap, RoughnessMap, MetalnessMap from the upload files of its textureSet; no NormalMap). Neon parts: Material Neon, no SurfaceAppearance. Glass: Material Glass, Transparency 0.65, Reflectance 0.2. Collider: Transparency 1.
Build the set from set.instances in a folder far from the arena; it is client-side (clone it on the client for the launch). The red room is cloned per player under their own bay.
Attachments: create under the asset's main part with WorldCFrame = pivot * CFrame.lookAt(position, position + look, up).
The palette textures are nearest-colour cells (8 px); the cells are sorted by colour so mips stay clean.
styleRules: Style A: chunky volumes at true scale, flat facets, built members as chamfered prisms; nothing under 0.25 stud except bolts and trim.

Colour: the brief's semi-real tones (UpcomingFilm_Brief section 2.8), +-6% per volume, +-3% per facet, warm tops and cool undersides, AO >= 0.5; each surface's mean after AO is normalised to the tone. Saturated colour only on the red rails and lamps and the light sources.
Darkness comes from the lighting, never the paint: no painted value below luma 40 (grates); built surfaces 55-215.
